svg.aria-label: Fig. L1 Branch prediction lineage: TAGE and ITTAGE beside what the M1 measures as
svg.text: Fig. L1 Branch prediction lineage: TAGE and ITTAGE beside what the M1 measures as
Left: the published mechanism, redrawn. Right: the M1 version from the measurements. Between them, what Apple kept, changed and added. Nothing on the left is a claim about Apple.
Seznec and Michaud, JILP 2006; Seznec, CBP 2014 and 2016
TAGE synopsis, Fig. 2 of the CBP papers (verified)
index_i = hash(PC, h[0:L_i]), L1 < L2 < L3 < L4 geometric; entry: 3 bit signed ctr, 8 to 12 bit tag, 1 to 2 bit u
Allocate on a mispredict into a longer table whose u is 0; u set when the provider beats altpred. TAGE-SC-L (Fig. 1, 2014) adds a loop
predictor and a statistical corrector after the TAGE output. History is outcomes plus a short path history (27 bits in 2016).
Nair, MICRO 1995: path based correlation. A shift register of recent branch addresses, not outcomes, indexes the counters.
reason for the tag: TAGE is
index_i = PC[18:2] XOR fold(path, L_i), split by PC bit 6 so two branches of one 128 B block read together
base predictor: not measured, drawn absent; a bimodal T0 is the TAGE default and likely (mine)
path record: on a taken or indirect branch, shift 1 and XOR in PC bits 2 to 24 and the 19 offset bits (cond) or PC 2 to 5, 25 to 30 and target 2 to 30 (indirect)
about 44 000 entries in all (derived); 13 cycle mispredict (corroborated); no privilege or ASID tag (measured)
The loop predictor and retire time training are patent readings; the statistical corrector has no measurement either way.
Open: whether the six tables are banked by PC bit 6 into two physical halves or one array read twice.
same skeleton as TAGE; the entry carries a target; path history from indirect target and PC bits (10 per indirect, 5 per call)
Chang, Hao and Patt, ISCA 1997: target cache indexed by jump PC XOR a path register of partial targets, the earlier form (figure unverified).
no context tag: a target from
1024 entries in all (measured); table count and lengths are mine
Return targets come from the RAS, not here; a return is marked by end type in the fetch group table (see Fig. M1).
How the lineage tag is meant
an Apple patent cites the paper, or an Apple engineer is an author
the measured structure matches the paper's figure field for field, with changes that are parameter choices
the measured behaviour fits the paper's mechanism but another published mechanism would fit as well
a published mechanism the measurements show the M1 does not use
Lineage is a claim about design ancestry, not about the M1, so it gets its own tag and never a measurement glyph. Paper panels are redrawn from the papers' own figures, not copied.
